COLSA is hiring a Python Software Developer to support NASA aerospace capabilities and data applications. The role develops and operates Python software, data pipelines, analytics and machine learning features, dashboards, and related documentation and operational processes while collaborating with developers, data staff, and program staff.

Responsibilities
Develop, maintain, and operate software and data applications supporting ACPO
Build and maintain data pipelines and workflows that prepare, validate, and integrate data from multiple sources
Implement applied analytics and machine learning features that support ACPO analysis and decision making
Build interactive dashboards and tools that make data usable for engineers, analysts, and program staff
Support data quality, testing, documentation, and day-to-day operations of delivered software
Collaborate with other developers, data staff, and program staff to deliver working software
